quests.title: The First Light
quests.summary: Mira welcomes you to Caetherra Sunlit Plaza. Look past the Prism's warmth and earn your first true resonance.

stages.objective: Speak with Mira in Caetherra Sunlit Plaza.
stages.hint: Select Mira and send a thoughtful message.

stages.objective: Acquire a Prism Lantern from Solstice Crossing or Caetherra.
stages.hint: Visit Lanternwright's Bazaar or earn it through dialogue.

stages.objective: Reach 450.0 Resonance and witness a Veil state shift.
stages.hint: Deepen bonds or advance the Veil cycle.

quests.title: Lanterns on the Rim
quests.summary: Travel west to Solstice Crossing and learn how the Lanternwrights measure Echoes along the Prism Marches.

stages.hint: Use the World Map to travel from Caetherra.

stages.objective: Speak with Kaelen the Lanternwright and purchase or inspect a relic.
stages.hint: Open the Market or talk with Kaelen.

quests.title: Curated Peace
quests.summary: The Stillward's serenity feels timeless—perhaps too timeless. Carry your lantern north and uncover what lies beneath the cloister.

stages.objective: Unlock and enter The Stillward Cloister.
stages.hint: Equip or carry the Prism Lantern with >= 400.0 resonance.

stages.objective: Question the Warden about the Stilling Bell.
stages.hint: Engage the Warden in deep dialogue.

stages.objective: Pass the Stillward Resonance Trial during a Storm or Quasar state.
stages.hint: Trigger the encounter in The Stillward.

quests.title: What the Forges Keep
quests.summary: Vael tests those who cross into Ashveil. Earn passage into the Ember Vaults and confront Vault Seven.

stages.objective: Travel to Ashveil Furnaces and speak with Vael.
Descend to The Memory Anvil in the Ember Vaults.
Speak with The Rendered about Vault Seven.
stages.hint: Engage The Rendered in the Ember Vaults.

quests.title: Echoes of the Nine
quests.summary: Step beyond surface comfort into The Hollow and survive the Dark Quasar with your trust intact.

stages.objective: Survive a Quasar Gravity Trial at Obsidian Reach.
stages.hint: Prove your trust was earned, not gifted.
